translation:
The spleen corresponds to the center, wu-ji earth; the mouth and tongue dwell together, unblocking the viscera and bowels. Mouth dry is spleen-heat; liver and gallbladder (disorder) is sour; lung-pungent, heart-salty, heart-heat is bitter.
Tongue protruding, not taken back, is yang-hardening (yang qiang); tongue shrinking, hard to speak — it makes the (mother-child) life in peril. Mouth and tongue ulcerated, suddenly engender sores; the throat, drool-spreading, bitter is hard to bear.
Double-tongue and wood-tongue, the tongue root stiff; with additions and subtractions, the vanguard is Jiegeng Tang (Platycodon Decoction). The above-the-stroke the Fuyan Tang (Attend-the-Feast Decoction) may be used; with the golden needle, poke and treat, creating the cosmos.
Fuyan Tang (Attend-the-Feast Decoction) uses the three-yellow (Huanglian/Huangqin/Huangbai); Baijian (百煎/百部?) with Zhizi (Gardenia), Tian-Maimen (Tianmendong-Ophiopogon). Ganjiang (Dried Ginger), Xixin (Asarum) and Pengsha (Borax) powder; one cup flung away, it quells the burning source.
translator_notes: 重舌=double tongue; 木舌=wood (stiff) tongue; 桔梗湯=Jiegeng Tang; 赴宴湯=Fuyan Tang.
unresolved: "百煎" obscure; possibly 百部 or 五味子 processed.
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
The teeth are the surplus of bone, the surface (table) of the kidney; upper and lower tooth pain dwell in kidney-heat. When the upper part aches, stomach-deficiency-heat; the lower segment, large-intestine wind-heat deficiency.
Stomach disease likes cold, dislikes drinking heat; the large intestine drinks heat and fears cold, in fear. If opening the mouth and drawing in wind and pain, the yangming wind-qi can be expelled and removed.
The teeth shaking and not firm and strong, the stomach-qi weak and deficient with flaw; the tooth interstices streaming pus and also bleeding, the gum decline with bone exposed — what awaits?
The bone-trough wind (alveolar abscess) turns into flowing-abscess; the yangming damp-heat, do not hesitate; Qingwei Tang Wan (Clear-the-Stomach Decoction-Pill) with additions and subtractions use; the Dazun Sanzi (Honor-the-Noble Powder) is certainly without constraint.
Qingwei Tang (Clear-the-Stomach Decoction) uses Sichuan Huanglian (Coptis); Dang Gui, Shengdi (Rehmannia), Puxiao (Mirabilitum) and salt. Danpi (Moutan Bark) and Digupi (Lycium Root Bark) must be used together; Shengma (Cimicifuga) as deputy-envoy, with Chaihu (Bupleurum) and Qianhu (Peucedanum).

Dazun San (Honor-the-Noble Powder)
Shigao (Gypsum) one liang, Bai Zhi five qian, Xixin (Asarum) five qian, Gancao (Licorice) one qian.
translator_notes: 齒乃腎表=the teeth are the surface/manifestation of the kidney; 骨之餘=surplus remnant of bone.
清胃湯=Qingwei Tang; 達尊散=Dazun San.
unresolved: "斷"/下斷" technical term for gum; rendered as gum/segment.
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
The pharynx swallows food and unblocks the stomach duct; the larynx awaits the qi and unblocks the five viscera. Side by side they stand between the lung gates; clear and turbid, prolonged, heat and cold.
Viscera-heat swelling-heat, much pain and itch; lung-cold shrinking-hard and much phlegm. If suddenly one perceives swelling and pain, water and gruel hard to enter, speech hard.
At both sides of the epiglottis all is swollen and painful — commonly named throat-block (houbi), issuing a double 橋 (shout); at one side of the epiglottis swollen and protruding — this is throat-closure (houbi), issuing a single 橋 (shout).
This is minister-fire engendering and sending it; with the golden needle, prick it and rouse the deep chronic ailment.
unresolved: "發雙哦/發單哦" obscure; rendered literally as issuing double/single shout.
